A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 16-page versions of the same EgoMask work. Their text, tables, figures and appendices A-G are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original dataset statistics, grounding and fine-tuning experiments, annotation-quality assessments, ablations and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains the original empirical results and adds kitchen versus non-kitchen performance results in appendix Table 9.

M1.justification: The SAM2 mask-annotation pipeline, two GPT-4o expression-generation strategies, and model fine-tuning and inference procedures remain unchanged. Figure 2 and the prompts in Figures 7-8 retain the same content.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation datasets and task coverage are unchanged. Kitchen and non-kitchen scenes already appear in v1, including Figures 9 and 11-12; v2 reports their performance separately within the existing EgoMask benchmark. HD-EPIC is discussed but not evaluated.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain Grounded-SAM2, Sa2VA-4B/26B, VideoLISA-3.8B and the fine-tuned variants. Appendix E retains GPT-4o and Gemini-Pro. The new domain analysis uses two existing methods without changing comparator membership in retained experiments.

E3.justification: V2 adds a kitchen/non-kitchen evaluation grouping in Table 9. Original duration splits, metrics, model sizes and training settings remain unchanged. The additional grouping's sample sizes and reported metric are not specified.

E4.justification: New Table 9 compares Grounded-SAM2 and Sa2VA-26B across kitchen and non-kitchen scenes, adding a limited analysis of performance variation by domain. Existing initialization, speed, object-characteristic and qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for model performance. The new domain table continues reporting point estimates without uncertainty; existing annotation-verification reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: V2 Table 9 adds kitchen/non-kitchen scores of 40.19/38.59 for Grounded-SAM2 and 31.07/29.95 for Sa2VA-26B. These are newly reported subgroup results, with no corresponding v1 entries. Matched existing numerical results and qualitative examples remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The grounding-metric definitions in Section 4.1 and trajectory/disappearance definitions in Appendix F are unchanged. Neither version presents formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: EgoMask and EgoMask-Train, analysis of egocentric/exocentric differences, and improved grounding through fine-tuning while retaining exocentric performance. The new domain table does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning SAM2 initialization, query understanding, small-object failures, background-frame metrics and exocentric transfer are unchanged. The domain table adds no accompanying mechanism explanation, applicability qualification or limitation.

D1.justification: Annotation sampling, generation prompts, hardware, learning rates, batch sizes, training budgets and the code-access link are unchanged. The new domain table supplies no additional implementation or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds HD-EPIC and reference 36, describing its longer pixel-level object tracks while distinguishing its kitchen-only coverage and lack of referring expressions. This is a limited extension of the existing dataset positioning.

P1.justification: V2 adds a related-work sentence and bibliography entry and updates appendix cross-references. The main exposition, terminology and section order remain intact, with no extensive rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: V2 inserts the domain-comparison Table 9 on PDF page 13. The previous expression-statistics Table 9 becomes Table 10 and moves to the opposite column; subsequent tables are renumbered and surrounding text reflows. Existing figures and table designs are retained.

improvement.justification: The HD-EPIC discussion makes research positioning more complete, and the new domain breakdown adds a limited check of performance across environments. These gains are modest: Table 9 omits its metric, subgroup sizes and uncertainty, limiting interpretation. The central methods, evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
